issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies the lecture attributes as private, and the solution implementation declares them as private, but the template declares some attributes as public (e.g., lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents). This visibility mismatch between the template and the intended design can confuse students about the expected encapsulation and access patterns (getters/setters) and may lead them to implement attributes with incorrect visibility.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template Lecture.java to declare all attributes as private and add the remaining attributes shown in the UML. For example: private String lectureName; private int numberOfInscribedStudents; private int numberOfGuestStudents; private int numberOfLecturers; private int numberOfTutors;. This will align the template with the UML and the solution and make the expected use of getters/setters clear.
